questions.description: Where and when the founders met, how long they have known each other, and how they ended up starting a company together.

questions.text: Whose idea was the company, and what work happened before you teamed up?
questions.description: Who came up with the idea, what each founder built or contributed before the other joined (code, research, customers, money), and whether any of it was done while employed elsewhere.

questions.text: What will each of you be responsible for?
questions.description: Each founder's title and areas of ownership, whether both work full time, and when anyone who is part time expects to go full time.

questions.text: How will you make decisions when you disagree?
questions.description: Which decisions need both founders, who has the final say in each area, and how a deadlock is broken.

questions.text: How do you plan to split ownership?
questions.description: The percentage each founder owns, the reasoning behind the split, and whether a pool is set aside for future hires.

questions.text: How should each founder's shares vest?
questions.description: Vesting length and cliff, whether earlier work earns any vested shares up front, and what happens to unvested shares if a founder leaves.
